events.description: Waits at a red-light intersection at night while several cars cross and turn through the crosswalk.
Raises a wrist and checks a smartwatch while waiting at the intersection.
Crosses the intersection and transitions from the street into a lamp-lit park path.
Rides a bicycle along winding, illuminated park paths, with its headlight shining on the pavement and a purple bag visible at the handlebars.
Approaches and passes park users, including a pedestrian with a leashed dog near the path.
Arrives beside a Citi Bike docking row, stops, and handles the bicycle controls before leaving the bike area.
Continues on foot through the park and an adjoining paved plaza toward the street edge.
Walks along a roadside sidewalk lined with parked taxis and other vehicles.
Rounds the end of the taxi-lined block and negotiates a curved road junction to reach a broader sidewalk.
Briefly checks the smartwatch near the road junction.
Walks steadily along a broad waterfront-side urban sidewalk between apartment buildings, parked cars, large planters, and a raised roadway barrier.
Passes pedestrians on the sidewalk, including a person accompanied by a small dog.
Looks down at the smartwatch again while continuing along the sidewalk.
Turns toward the barrier and spends time looking over the illuminated elevated highway, lower roadway, and distant waterfront lights.
Returns to the street corner and crosses or turns through a side-street intersection as vehicles pass.
Resumes walking along the building-side sidewalk, passing planters and parked cars toward another stop-controlled intersection.
Checks the smartwatch shortly after reaching the next sidewalk.

warnings: Event boundaries are approximate because the source was uniformly sampled at roughly six-second intervals.
